from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions, status
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from django_hooks.models import Hook
from .models import CIBuildProject

class RegisterOutboundHookView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request):
        project_id = request.data.get('project_id')
        target_url = request.data.get('target_url')
        event_name = request.data.get('event_name', 'build.finished')

        if not project_id or not target_url:
            return Response({'error': 'project_id and target_url required'}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        project = get_object_or_404(CIBuildProject, id=project_id, members=request.user, member__role='admin')

        hook = Hook.objects.create(
            user=request.user,
            target=target_url,
            event=event_name,
            project_id=project.id
        )
        return Response({'hook_id': hook.id, 'status': 'registered'}, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
